scores.tell: none; goal frame has thin straight posts and thin net lines, crisp planar form like real cards
stool seats slightly puffy and bar counter a touch soft, otherwise thin parts and part count fine
sphere is a perfect orb and the stand's curled feet are thin but toy-like; very simple smooth silhouette
flat console body has tight edges and thin headband; knobs and sliders small. Slightly plump housing
cactus arms are fat sausage tubes with fully rounded ends, pillow-like body, no flat or thin parts
rocket is a smooth swollen capsule; fins chunky and the nose cap rim is a thick roll, but the form is plausible
planks are flat with straight edges, posts cylinders; slight softness on post tops and rope roll
the box is puffy with rounded soft corners; the drawer panel is pillowy, and the joystick and handle are thickened
vehicle is a chunky toy blob with oversized fat wheels and rounded body; corners are soft everywhere
coral branches are thick soft sausages with blobby tips and rocks are rounded lumps; no crisp edges
